## What problem does this solve

Describe the situation where SVRF's current behavior isn't enough — a scheduling case
it doesn't handle, a configuration it doesn't expose, a check it doesn't run.

## Proposed behavior

What you'd want SVRF to do instead. If it changes a documented invariant (see the "How
it stays safe" table in the README) or one of the rules in `src/svrf/rules.py`, say which
one and how.

## Alternatives considered

Any workaround you're using today (a wrapper script, a different merge queue, a manual
step), and why it's not enough.

## Additional context

Links, examples, or a sketch of the configuration shape you'd expect.
